find_cards_by_name.description: Find every card whose name contains the text given: "agumon" brings back Agumon and every one of its dozens of printings and forms. The way to turn a name a person typed into card numbers. No API key required.

cards.main_effect:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[Your Turn] While this Digimon's digivolution cards include a Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait or a red Tamer card, it gets +4000 DP.
cards.name: Aldamon

parameters.description: The name, or part of one, to search for. For example "greymon" or "omnimon".
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Optional. Only cards of this colour.
parameters.name: color

parameters.description: Optional. Only cards of this type: a Digimon, an Option, a Tamer or a Digi-Egg.
parameters.name: card_type

parameters.description: Optional. Which of the three Digimon card games to search. Leave blank for all of them; the 2020 Digimon Card Game is the one in print.

parameters.description: Optional. How to order the cards. Leave blank for the database's own order. Random draws afresh from every matching card on each request, so it has no next page and ignores Skip: ask for as many cards as you need at once, up to 1,000.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Optional. Which way to order the cards. Only applies alongside Sort by.
parameters.name: sort_direction

parameters.description: Optional. How many cards to return, up to 1000. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Optional. How many cards to skip before returning results. Use the result's next_offset to walk through a long list; paging costs no extra request.
parameters.name: offset

alt_effect.description: The card's security effect or its second half of text. Empty when it has none.

artist.description: The illustrator. Empty when digimoncard.io has no credit.

attribute.description: Attribute, e.g. Vaccine, Virus, Data, Free or Variable.

card_number.description: The number printed on the card, e.g. BT4-016. Get a card takes it.

card_page_url.description: Link to the card's page on digimoncard.io, built from its slug.

color2.description: Its second colour, for a two-coloured card. Empty otherwise.

colors.description: Both colours as one list, so a two-coloured card can be matched without reading two fields.

date_added.description: When digimoncard.io added the card, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Not the card's release date.

digi_type.description: The Digimon's first Digi-Type (trait), e.g. Wizard.

digi_type2.description: Its second Digi-Type, when it has one. Empty otherwise.

digi_types.description: Every Digi-Type the card has, up to five, as one list. The Digi-Type filters match any of them.

dp.description: The Digimon's DP: the power it battles with. Empty for cards that do not battle.

evolution_color.description: The colour the Digimon underneath has to be to digivolve.

evolution_cost.description: What it costs to digivolve into this Digimon from a legal source. Empty when the card cannot be digivolved into.

evolution_level.description: The level the Digimon underneath has to be.

form.description: The Digimon's form, e.g. Rookie, Champion, Ultimate, Mega or Hybrid.

image_url.description: Link to the card's artwork, built from its card number. Download and re-host it rather than hotlinking.

level.description: The card's level: 2 for a Digi-Egg, 3 to 7 for a Digimon. Empty for Options and Tamers, which have none.

play_cost.description: What it costs in memory to play the card from hand.

pretty_url.description: The card's slug on digimoncard.io, e.g. aldamon-bt4-016.

series.description: Which Digimon card game the card belongs to.

sets.description: Every product the card was printed in, named the way the pack filters take them, e.g. BT-04: Booster Great Legend.

source_effect.description: The inherited effect the card gives whatever digivolves on top of it. Empty when it has none.

stage.description: The card's stage, e.g. Rookie or Mega. Empty on many cards.

has_more.description: Whether more cards are left after this page.

total_count.description: How many cards matched in total.

cards.description: The matching cards, in the requested order.

alt_effect.description: The card's security effect or its second half of text. Empty when it has none.

artist.description: The illustrator. Empty when digimoncard.io has no credit.

attribute.description: Attribute, e.g. Vaccine, Virus, Data, Free or Variable.

card_number.description: The number printed on the card, e.g. BT4-016. Get a card takes it.

card_page_url.description: Link to the card's page on digimoncard.io, built from its slug.

color2.description: Its second colour, for a two-coloured card. Empty otherwise.

colors.description: Both colours as one list, so a two-coloured card can be matched without reading two fields.

date_added.description: When digimoncard.io added the card, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Not the card's release date.

digi_type.description: The Digimon's first Digi-Type (trait), e.g. Wizard.

digi_type2.description: Its second Digi-Type, when it has one. Empty otherwise.

digi_types.description: Every Digi-Type the card has, up to five, as one list. The Digi-Type filters match any of them.

dp.description: The Digimon's DP: the power it battles with. Empty for cards that do not battle.

evolution_color.description: The colour the Digimon underneath has to be to digivolve.

evolution_cost.description: What it costs to digivolve into this Digimon from a legal source. Empty when the card cannot be digivolved into.

evolution_level.description: The level the Digimon underneath has to be.

form.description: The Digimon's form, e.g. Rookie, Champion, Ultimate, Mega or Hybrid.

image_url.description: Link to the card's artwork, built from its card number. Download and re-host it rather than hotlinking.

level.description: The card's level: 2 for a Digi-Egg, 3 to 7 for a Digimon. Empty for Options and Tamers, which have none.

play_cost.description: What it costs in memory to play the card from hand.

pretty_url.description: The card's slug on digimoncard.io, e.g. aldamon-bt4-016.

rarity.description: Rarity code in capitals, e.g. C, U, R, SR, SEC or P. The older games spell theirs out, e.g. Common.

series.description: Which Digimon card game the card belongs to.

sets.description: Every product the card was printed in, named the way the pack filters take them, e.g. BT-04: Booster Great Legend.

source_effect.description: The inherited effect the card gives whatever digivolves on top of it. Empty when it has none.

stage.description: The card's stage, e.g. Rookie or Mega. Empty on many cards.

tcgplayer_id.description: Always empty: digimoncard.io no longer sends a TCGplayer id. Kept so a workflow that reads it keeps running.

tcgplayer_name.description: Always empty: digimoncard.io no longer sends a TCGplayer name. Kept so a workflow that reads it keeps running.

type.description: Card type: Digimon, Option, Tamer or Digi-Egg.

xros_requirement.description: The DigiXros condition, for a card that is played by DigiXros instead of being digivolved. Empty for every other card.

count.description: How many cards this page returned.

has_more.description: Whether more cards are left after this page.

next_offset.description: The offset that reads the next page. Empty on the last page.

offset.description: How many cards were skipped to reach this page.

total_count.description: How many cards matched in total.

description: Look up Digimon Trading Card Game cards on digimoncard.io: search by name, rules text, colour, card type, attribute, Digi-Type, pack, level, play cost, DP or digivolution cost, list what is in any booster set, and read each card's costs, DP, effects, the sets it was printed in and an artwork link. Covers all three Digimon card games. No account or API key required.
